title: Underwhelmed for disney
text:
The January shirt was my first shirt and it is okay. The t shirt itself is good quality, soft, thick and flattering. However it fits more snug than other shirts of the same size. The design is bland, underwhelming and not suoer sharp. It looks blurry and pixelated. I am also disappointed the actual shirt is white. I am going to give February a try but if I am still disappointed I won't be continuing my subscription.

EDIT I was also unimpressed with the February shirt design quality so I have cancelled my subscription
label: neutral
